Alan Franco.note: Franco is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Alan Franco.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Alan Minda.note: Minda is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Alan Minda.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Angelo Preciado.note: Preciado is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Angelo Preciado.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Anthony Valencia.note: Valencia's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Anthony Valencia.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Denil Castillo.note: Castillo's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Denil Castillo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Enner Valencia.note: Valencia stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Enner Valencia.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Felix Torres.note: Torres's signature is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Felix Torres.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Gonzalo Plata.note: Plata is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Gonzalo Plata.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Gonzalo Valle.note: Valle's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Gonzalo Valle.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Hernan Galindez.note: Galíndez stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He waits for the strike before committing.
Hernan Galindez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。

Jackson Porozo.note: Porozo stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Jackson Porozo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Jeremy Arevalo.note: Arévalo stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Jeremy Arevalo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Joel Ordonez.note: Ordóñez stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Joel Ordonez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

John Yeboah.note: Watch Yeboah for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
John Yeboah.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Jordy Alcivar.note: Alcívar's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Jordy Alcivar.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Jordy Caicedo.note: Caicedo stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Jordy Caicedo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Kendry Paez.note: Páez stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Kendry Paez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Kevin Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Kevin Rodriguez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Moises Caicedo.note: Caicedo's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Moises Caicedo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Moises Ramirez.note: Ramírez's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Moises Ramirez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会直塞球越过后防时及时出击。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Nilson Angulo.note: Angulo's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Nilson Angulo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Pedro Vite.note: Vite is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Pedro Vite.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Pervis Estupinan.note: Estupiñán's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Pervis Estupinan.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Piero Hincapie.note: Hincapié stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Piero Hincapie.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Willian Pacho.note: Watch Pacho for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Willian Pacho.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Yaimar Medina.note: Medina's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Yaimar Medina.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。
